∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field.{u} k] (V : Type v) [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{v} V] [inst_2 : Module.{u, v} k V]
  [Module.Finite.{u, v} k V] (n : Nat) [IsAlgClosed.{u} k] [CharZero.{u} k],
  Exists.{2} fun iota =>
    Exists.{1} fun x =>
      Exists.{1} fun x =>
        Exists.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} fun S =>
          Exists.{1} fun label =>
            Exists.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} fun specht =>
              And
                (∀ (p : n.Partition), Subsingleton.{1} (Subtype.{1} fun i => Eq.{1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} label i) p))
                (And
                  (∀ (i : iota),
                    IsSimpleModule.{max u v, max (max v u) u v}
                      (Subtype.{(max u v) + 1} fun x =>
                        Membership.mem.{max u v, max u v}
                          (Subalgebra.centralizer.{u, max u v} k
                            (SetLike.coe.{max u v, max u v} (Etingof.symGroupImage.{u, v} k V n)))
                          x)
                      (LinearMap.{max u v, max u v, max u v, max v u}
                        (RingHom.id.{max u v}
                          (Subtype.{(max u v) + 1} fun x =>
                            Membership.mem.{max u v, max u v} (Etingof.symGroupImage.{u, v} k V n) x))
                        (Subtype.{(max u v) + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{max u v, max u v} (S i) x)
                        (Etingof.TensorPower.{u, v} k V n)))
                  (And
                    (∀ (i j : iota),
                      Nonempty.{(max (max v u) u v) + 1}
                          (LinearEquiv.{max u v, max u v, max (max v u) u v, max (max v u) u v}
                            (RingHom.id.{max u v}
                              (Subtype.{(max u v) + 1} fun x =>
                                Membership.mem.{max u v, max u v}
                                  (Subalgebra.centralizer.{u, max u v} k
                                    (SetLike.coe.{max u v, max u v} (Etingof.symGroupImage.{u, v} k V n)))
                                  x))
                            (LinearMap.{max u v, max u v, max u v, max v u}
                              (RingHom.id.{max u v}
                                (Subtype.{(max u v) + 1} fun x =>
                                  Membership.mem.{max u v, max u v} (Etingof.symGroupImage.{u, v} k V n) x))
                              (Subtype.{(max u v) + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{max u v, max u v} (S i) x)
                              (Etingof.TensorPower.{u, v} k V n))
                            (LinearMap.{max u v, max u v, max u v, max v u}
                              (RingHom.id.{max u v}
                                (Subtype.{(max u v) + 1} fun x =>
                                  Membership.mem.{max u v, max u v} (Etingof.symGroupImage.{u, v} k V n) x))
                              (Subtype.{(max u v) + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{max u v, max u v} (S j) x)
                              (Etingof.TensorPower.{u, v} k V n))) →
                        Eq.{1} i j)
                    (And
                      (∀ (i : iota) (a : MonoidAlgebra.{u, 0} k (Equiv.Perm.{1} (Fin n)))
                        (x : Subtype.{(max u v) + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{max u v, max u v} (S i) x),
                        Eq.{u + 1}
                          (DFunLike.coe.{max (u + 1) (v + 1), max (u + 1) (v + 1), u + 1} (specht i)
                            (HSMul.hSMul.{max u v, max u v, max u v}
                              (DFunLike.coe.{max (u + 1) (v + 1), u + 1, max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
                                (Etingof.symGroupAlgHomToImage.{u, v} k V n) a)
                              x))
                          (HSMul.hSMul.{u, u, u} a
                            (DFunLike.coe.{max (u + 1) (v + 1), max (u + 1) (v + 1), u + 1} (specht i) x)))
                      (Exists.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} fun e =>
                        ∀
                          (b :
                            Subtype.{(max u v) + 1} fun x =>
                              Membership.mem.{max u v, max u v} (Etingof.diagonalActionImage.{u, v} k V n) x)
                          (x_1 : Etingof.TensorPower.{u, v} k V n),
                          Eq.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
                            (DFunLike.coe.{max (u + 1) (v + 1), max (u + 1) (v + 1), max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
                              (Etingof.PartitionBimoduleDecompositionEquiv.toLinearEquiv.{u, max u v, 0} e)
                              (DFunLike.coe.{max (u + 1) (v + 1), max (u + 1) (v + 1), max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
                                (Subtype.val.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} b) x_1))
                            (DFunLike.coe.{max (u + 1) (v + 1), max (u + 1) (v + 1), max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
                              (Etingof.partitionBimoduleCentralizerAction.{u, max u v, 0} k n S label
                                (Subtype.mk.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} (Subtype.val.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} b) ⋯))
                              (DFunLike.coe.{max (u + 1) (v + 1), max (u + 1) (v + 1), max (u + 1) (v + 1)}
                                (Etingof.PartitionBimoduleDecompositionEquiv.toLinearEquiv.{u, max u v, 0} e) x_1))))))

∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : Field.{u_1} k] [CharZero.{u_1} k] [inst_2 : IsAlgClosed.{u_1} k] (N : Nat) {n : Nat}
  (la : n.Partition),
  And
    (Iff (Eq.{u_1 + 1} (Etingof.SchurModulePSubmodule.{u_1} k N la) Bot.bot.{u_1})
      (LT.lt.{0} N (Multiset.card.{0} la.parts)))
    (LE.le.{0} (Multiset.card.{0} la.parts) N →
      And
        (Eq.{1} (Etingof.formalCharacter.{u_1} k N (Etingof.SchurModuleP.{u_1} k N la))
          (Etingof.schurPoly N (Etingof.partWeight N la)))
        (Eq.{1}
          (Nat.cast.{0}
            (Module.finrank.{u_1, u_1} k
              (FGModuleCat.carrier.{u_1, u_1} (Action.V.{u_1, u_1 + 1, u_1} (Etingof.SchurModuleP.{u_1} k N la)))))
          (Etingof.weylDimension N (Etingof.partWeight N la))))
